payload.rebuttal: fixed: test_each_fact_the_ledger_appends_emits_one_event_naming_its_kind_and_key only checked the set of fact kinds taken, never a count or per-kind content. A record_findings edit that appends only its first fact and silently drops the rest still leaves the kind "finding" present in that set (via the surviving first fact), so the test passed under that mutant. I added an exact total count assertion (len(facts) == 22, the true number _drive_every_kind writes) and an exact ordered check of both findings' claims (finding_claims == ["claim one", "claim two"]). Under the drop-second-fact mutant the total falls to 21 and the claims list has only one entry, so both new assertions fail. Verified by reapplying the exact mutant and confirming the witness fails, then restoring saffron/ledger.py and re-running the full suite green.
